profile.headline: Looking For Full-Time Opportunities in Software Development/ Software Engineering Field
profile.summary:
I am a recent graduate in Computer Science and completed my Master's Degree from the University of Texas at Dallas.
 
I have always interest in Machine learning and Artificial intelligence. I completed the machine learning course at the University of Texas at Dallas in the first semester. I have completed projects on Machine learning in my undergraduate program and also in my master's program. One of them was Digit Recognition, in which I created classification models such as SVM, Decision Tree, Deep Neural network and ANN to predict a digit from the pixels of a handwritten image of digit and evaluate the models on some evaluation matrixes.

The second project was about a Book recommendation system in which I made a system using Machine learning (SVM) to find a recommendation for the user based on the user's interest and user-user similarly.

Apart from that, I always read Questions of different competitions like ACM icpc, Hacker rank, Code chef etc.  and apply my knowledge to solve such questions very efficiently. I did research on web Delta mining to mine the data from a website or web page.
I have good commands on the database. I like to work in BackEnd and play with Data efficiently.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Helped, Developed and Maintained ERP, CRM and E-Commerce-related applications using a .net framework, MongoDB, SQL server. Added very efficient parsers to retrieve information from the email server and customer ticket system.

Technologies : C#, Object Oriented Programming, MongoDB, SQL, JavaScript, Web Designing, ASP.net

projects.title: Question Answer System
projects.description: Create Heuristic  based search model  upon NLP features to extract the answer of the Given question.  Implemented efficient search query and  developed NLP based Pipeline model with the use of spacy, NLTK, Wordnet etc.

projects.title: Real Time News Stream Classifier
projects.description: Developed an Apache Spark Pipeline model to predict category of News using PySpark and ML Library on batch type live stream of News Data. With the Help of Apache Kafka, we Created a topic in which we publish News data as a Kafka message and using Kafka-consumer script we fed topic data to trained pipeline to make prediction over test data.
